europe_now.title: Europe: Raging wildfires scorch large swaths of the continent
europe_now.summary: Multiple nations are facing intense wildfire activity that destroys large areas of land. These disasters disrupt critical infrastructure and strain emergency response systems across the region.

europe_now.title: France's top court blocks social media ban for under-15s
europe_now.summary: The French constitutional court invalidated a law aimed at limiting social media usage among teenagers. This ruling affects ongoing debates regarding digital rights and child protection policies in Europe.

europe_now.title: Europe: Raging wildfires scorch large swaths of the continent
europe_now.summary: Wildfires have spread across multiple European countries, leading to evacuations and extensive land damage. Emergency services are working to contain the fires and protect affected communities.

europe_now.title: Ukrainian drones wipe out elite US brigade in drills, as Europe bankrolls Kyiv and US aid falls to zero
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian drone strikes have destroyed an elite US brigade during training exercises in Europe. Meanwhile, European nations continue to fund Kyiv while US assistance has ceased.

top_stories.title: France's top court blocks social media ban for under-15s
top_stories.summary: France's top court has blocked a proposed ban on social media for users under 15 years old. The court's decision stops the ban from being implemented.

top_stories.title: Polish opposition expels 40 lawmakers who formed breakaway caucus led by ex-PM Morawiecki
top_stories.summary: Polish opposition parties have expelled 40 members who formed a breakaway caucus led by former Prime Minister Morawiecki. The expulsions follow the lawmakers' departure from the main opposition bloc.

top_stories.title: Southern Europe leads boom in young, high-growth firms, as Germany falls behind
top_stories.summary: Southern European countries are experiencing a surge in young, high-growth companies, outpacing Germany's growth. The development contrasts with Germany's slower performance in the same sector.
